caption:
Meituan posts earnings beat as price war cools

Meituan (HKEX: 3690) · Business

Profit was largely stable sequentially on higher third-quarter revenue at China's top food-delivery company. The company, China's top food-delivery operator, continued to recover from a brutal price war.

Reported by The Wall Street Journal.
